name: Armstrong Creek
intro_context: Armstrong Creek is the fastest-growing part of Geelong, a vast new-housing corridor south of the city where thousands of homes are being built on former farmland. Almost every block starts as a bare estate lot that needs cut and fill, retaining and a driveway before and after the build, and the flat-to-gently-falling ground and reactive clay soils make getting the levels and drainage right the difference between a smooth build and an expensive one.
chips_lede: Armstrong Creek sits at the centre of Geelong's biggest growth corridor. Most weeks we are working across the surrounding estates and the wider region.
